justifications.type_expressiveness: Good use of enums for Expr, Value, BinOp, UnOp, and EvalError variants, but ParseError and EvalError::TypeError still rely on stringly-typed messages rather than structured variants distinguishing specific cases.
justifications.error_handling: Typed error enums with the three required EvalError variants and offset-bearing ParseError, no panics in library paths, but TypeError wraps a String rather than structured data and a few unwraps lack explanatory comments.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Clean public surface with Display/Debug on errors, doc comments on most public items and functions, though BinOp/UnOp are exposed publicly without docs and some Expr fields lack documentation.
justifications.idiomaticity: Generally idiomatic Rust with ?, matches!, and proper enum patterns, but uses a Vec-based env with linear lookup and clones strings/values where borrowing or a HashMap-based scope could be cleaner.
